title: Supply the canonical diagonal data to the rational projective-line adjunction
statement: Let ell be a prime and k a field of positive prime characteristic different from ell. Let Y be separated of finite type over k, and suppose Y, its projective line and the product of that line with itself over Y are noetherian. For either rational coefficient convention of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], the actual restricted direct-image functor push of [det-prop-p1-adjunction-rational-unit-counit] is left adjoint to its actual restricted pullback-Tate-twist-shift functor exceptional. These are functors on the bounded-constructible localizing categories of [def-sfb-rational-localizing-twist].

source.place: Proof (3): use the rational projective-line adjunction; diagonal data supplied by the preceding diagonal-tower unit.

proof.text: Since ell and the positive characteristic of k are distinct primes, ell is a unit in k and hence in the global sections of Y. All sequence categories of module sheaves used in the diagonal tower are Grothendieck abelian: evaluate maps on components and use the coproduct of evaluation-left-adjoint generators. The module-sheaf coefficient-universe theorem supplies the completed coefficient category. Thus the required derived localizations exist.
Apply exists_diagonalTowerSystem to obtain a strict cycle system and its completion specification.

Apply diagonalTower_limit to the system, then completedLimit_exists to its specification. This extracts the unique completed arrow together with all finite normalization and completed compatibility data, exactly IsDiagonalLimit. The extraction is a fully proved generic witness rearrangement in a separate module; its native interface uses only the required category instances.
Apply diagonalTower_coefficients to obtain the coefficient Family and a Reference tied to that completed arrow.
Apply rationalP1_triangle to these data and retain the adjunction clause.

The remaining Lean work supplies the localization instances and the normalized diagonal limit and coefficient reference to the triangle theorem. C1 supplies the data by a continuation over abstract localization records and invokes the separately proved completed-limit extraction, with explicit native category instances and cached specification arguments.

lean.statement:
theorem rationalP1_adjunction_assembly
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)] :
    Nonempty (push ℓ c k (ringChar k) (Fact.out : ringChar k ≠ ℓ) Y ⊣
      exceptional ℓ c k (ringChar k) (Fact.out : ringChar k ≠ ℓ) Y)
